text: PepsiCo, Inc. closed the acquisition of Garza Food Ventures LLC, doing business as Siete Foods, for $1.2 billion in January 2025.

source.name: PepsiCo – 'PepsiCo Completes Acquisition of Siete Foods'
source.quote: closed the acquisition of Garza Food Ventures LLC, dba Siete Foods ("Siete"), for $1.2 billion.
